SELECT
    m.EmployeeKey AS ManagerKey,
    concat(m.FirstName, ' ', m.LastName) AS ManagerName,
    count() AS DirectReports,
    round(avg(dateDiff('day', toDate(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(e.HireDate)), today()) / 365.25), 2) AS AvgTenureYears
FROM retail.DimEmployee AS e
JOIN retail.DimEmployee AS m
    ON toInt32(e.ParentEmployeeKey) = m.EmployeeKey
WHERE e.ParentEmployeeKey IS NOT NULL
  AND e.HireDate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY m.EmployeeKey, ManagerName
ORDER BY DirectReports DESC
